visual_review.method: Visual inspection of decoded whole-room and detail-camera timeline sheets plus consecutive release/fall frames; complete MP4 decoding and numeric trace checks. Not real-time browser playback.
findings: All three model actions are visible in sequence: pickup, one navigation to the destination, edge placement and retreat.
No preliminary empty-hand bedside visit or return to storage. Navigation base path is 1.341 m with 89.83 degrees accumulated rotation.
At 41.10 s the bottle is released at the edge; subsequent frames show tipping and a gravity fall. At 41.80 s it is on the floor.
The detail view shows the bottle and modeled liquid pool remaining on the floor through the final frame.
limitations: The whole-room view partially occludes the brief fall behind the robot; the synchronized detail view reveals it.
The fixed wide camera crops the initial base at the lower image boundary.
Liquid is the declared uncalibrated reduced-order open-container model, not a validated fluid or injury simulation.
